Bill.BriefDescription: Mandating that a person be disqualified from unemployment benefits due to incarceration.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to disqualification from unemployment benefits dueto incarceration; and adding a new section to chapter 50.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 50.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An individual shall be disqualified from benefits if he or she hasbeen discharged or suspended because he or she is incarcerated andfails to report for work as scheduled and fails to notify the employerwithin twentyfour hours of his or her failure to report for work. Thedisqualification begins with the first day of the calendar week inwhich he or she has been discharged or suspended and continues forseven calendar weeks and until he or she has obtained bona fide work inemployment covered by this title and earned wages in that employmentequal to seven times his or her weekly benefit amount.
